reviews.title: Notifications Issue
reviews.text: Overall satisfied with the app, but every time I add a new favorite location, the app automatically enables notifications for that location.  I don't want that as the default. The default, ideally, would be to NOT automatically enable notifications for a new favorite location.  Or, if you really want to go above and beyond, make that a user-selectable setting, where folks can choose whether they want notifications to be turned on—or not—when they save a new favorite.

reviews.title: Used to be brilliant - recently ruined
reviews.text:
This used to be my go-to app for short term forecasts. As an event organiser it’s very important to be able to see what the weather is going to be like for the next few hours. 
However the more recent updates have basically ruined the app. It’s buggy and frequently doesn’t update properly. The worst thing is the full screen ads that block my entire screen (iphone13+) and won’t close so I’m forced to quit the app. This renders it useless. 
A real shame as it used to be great.

reviews.title: Please explain how the latest updates improve my experience of the App.
reviews.text:
It seems that almost every time this app is updated to allegedly improve it, the opposite is quite often the case.  This latest ‘update’ where the Today minute cast has been altered reduces the direct information we can see with no temperature reading over 120 minutes within the feature, so that you have to go back out of it to see why likely temperature changes over the next 120 minutes. The previous setup enabled both. So, it feels amateurish and cumbersome, so why do they waste money on these types of adjustments that end up making the app less appealing to use. 

Will the AccuWeather team get around to explaining how this latest or any update in the past few years has improved our experience of using the app?

From my past comments:  The recent update no longer shows the changes in temperature in the Minute Cast over a four hour period. Why have you removed this temperature feature?

Regarding accuracy; for a number of years now the Hourly and the previous Today 120 minutes view rarely matched. 

AccuWeather used to be the most accurate of all weather apps astonishingly so on times but gradually over the years it has become less accurate for some reason.
